title: Colored Branches of the Louisville Free Public Library: summary of work
lineage: Inspected indicated passages; local file contains paraphrased research notes.

passages.locator: History; Summary of work for fiscal year ending August 31, 1916
passages.note: The library reports opening on September 23 1905 in temporary premises and its fiscal year ending August 31 1916 Western circulation, adult 17,821 and juvenile 18,597, total 36,418; Western cards in force 4,025. The later 1908 Carnegie building is distinct. Text carries a 1915 title page and an appended summary for fiscal 1916; chronology of this transcription is noted.
